title: Warp layer stack
description: Typed tag and mono title over an ink-framed figure plate: a stack of full-width layer rows on a dot grid, each deeper in brand blue than the one above (a faint tint, a light wash, a mid wash, then solid blue with white text) and each title a little larger. A row carries a spaced 'LAYER 01' label, a geometric title, pill chips and a note at the right. An outline steps from row to row on a loop, lifting that row's chips to full strength.
notes: the stepping outline is CSS only (2 to 8 rows), desktop only; on phones and with reduced motion all chips stay at full strength
